free_text: A biopsy is recommended because the patient presents with a rising PSA trend, with values increasing from 7.4 ng/mL in April 2022 to 12.3 ng/mL in January 2025, coupled with a PI-RADS 5 lesion in the right peripheral zone on MRI. Although the prior biopsy was positive, the lack of documented prior grade or surveillance status necessitates further histological assessment to guide definitive management.
